class.name: Controller
class.brief_description: Base class for anything that can possess a [PawnHandler].
class.description: Holds the possession relationship. See [PlayerController] for the player-facing subclass. Controllers add themselves to [method GFGDSceneTree.get_controllers] from [code]_enter_tree[/code] and take themselves out again in [code]_exit_tree[/code], so the world list also picks up AI controllers and controllers a designer placed in a level by hand, and can never hold a freed one. [b]A subclass that overrides [code]_enter_tree[/code] or [code]_exit_tree[/code] must call the base implementation[/b], or it will never be registered - Godot binds only the most derived override.
